runtimeAdapter44.boundary: Reward-trained artificial recurrent policy on real MaleCNS topology, not validated biological learning. No circuit coordinates, centerline, teacher actions, target-speed formula or wall-following action law enters the policy.
runtimeAdapter44.algorithm: Rank-based diagonal evolution strategy with shared synaptic gains, elites and antithetic exploration
runtimeAdapter44.edgeBoundary: No edges added or removed. Sixteen positive learned gains modulate existing normalized anatomical edges by source-neuron group; millions of independent edge weights are not individually trained.
runtimeAdapter44.v4Boundary: All 166700 annotated nodes and 6242118 strong edges loaded. Approximate sparse recurrence reserves the 7721-node core within an 8192-slot budget, not all nodes simultaneously nonzero.
runtimeAdapter44.selection: Completed laps first, fastest lap second; measured progress before first lap; net reward minus severe penalties breaks ties.

runtimeAdapter43.status: Historical assisted controller; removed from current runtime
runtimeAdapter43.boundary: Artificial warm-start adapter over real CSR synapses, not biological learning; no circuit coordinates, waypoints, centerline or target trajectory enter the controller.
runtimeAdapter43.selection: Completed laps first, fastest lap second; progress before the first lap; net penalty score remains secondary.

credit: MaleCNS consortium: FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), University of Cambridge, MRC LMB, Google Research
selection: DNa01/DNa02; top 60 incoming neurons per output; top 3000 incoming neurons from the expanded central/visual/descending shell; top 4500 visual_projection inputs into the first two shells; top 1200 visual_projection nodes by induced outgoing synapse count receive the runtime sensor adapter. All 1200 input slots keep their eleven visual ray relays; the last 112 deterministic slots also receive 7 artificial vehicle-physics channels and 4 real-wall road-preview channels at a reduced adapter gain. The road-preview channels are additive and start neutral, so the historical visual/physics mapping remains compatible. Classes: ['ascending_neuron', 'cb_efferent', 'cb_intrinsic', 'cb_motor', 'descending_neuron', 'efferent_ascending', 'efferent_descending', 'visual_centrifugal', 'visual_projection']. All induced edges with >=5 synapses; remove nodes without a directed path to an output. Ties by bodyId. Each node includes the official somaLocation [x,y,z] for the 3D atlas.
modelBoundary: Real IDs, annotations, directed edges and integer synapse counts. This file describes reduced V3; complete V4 has its own manifest. Artificial rate dynamics, input injection, shared trainable synaptic gains and motor readout are not validated biology. Historical relay fields below describe the legacy adapter; runtimeAdapter44 describes current learning. Eleven wall rays, seven vehicle-physics and four wall-preview channels are simulation inputs, not biological annotations. Neurotransmitters and physiology are not simulated.
mapForwardRiskPenalty: 36 pt/s scaled by the deficit between forward wall clearance and the estimated braking corridor
narrowProfileVisualEncoding: side rays use close-wall normalization; the forward ray keeps the long-range distance gradient
